content: **Discovery:** Ralph PRD format — PRDs live at `.tvn/ralph/prd.md`. Structure: H1 title, description, then `## Task N: Title` sections separated by `---`. Each task needs `id: N`, `depends_on: [...]`, optional `test_command:` and `acceptance:` (bullet list with `  - ` prefix). Test commands on Windows MUST use `python -c "..."` with assertions — never Unix tools (grep/sed/awk/find). Agents must emit `<promise>COMPLETE</promise>` to mark task done. See `.tvn/ralph/prd_template.md` for full annotated example. Ralph auto-appends a memory maintenance task if `promote_on_complete` is true in ralph.json.
subject: Ralph PRD format
